taskBoundExtension.basis: Owner explicitly required a new implementation commit and prohibited history rewrite; this allowance is limited to that commit's author and committer metadata for the already-accepted identifier.

ownerAcknowledgement: The email/account identifier remains present in public Git author/committer metadata.
The identifier may be associated with the repository and the owner's public identity.
The audit must not describe the historical identifier as irreversibly redacted.
The home-path account alias may remain public.
The alias may be correlated with the accepted public email/account identifier.
Acceptance is limited to the owner's own alias and does not cover unrelated third-party personal data.
The historical mode-160000 path/object references may remain public.
This acceptance does not assert that inaccessible external content is license-compliant.
Stable release provenance and license closure cover only content actually distributed by this repository and final archive.
Active source and final packages must contain zero gitlinks and zero .gitmodules.

notAuthorized: concealment or deletion of audit findings
acceptance of unrelated third-party personal information
claiming inaccessible gitlink targets are license-compliant
automatic push, merge, tag, or GitHub Release
